findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on whitening](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/teeth-whitening) covers whitening and sensitivity.
findings.why: The link is to a real ADA consumer-site domain, but nothing in the post or the ficha confirms that this specific page covers sensitivity, so the claim it supports is unverified.
findings.fix: Open the linked page, confirm it discusses whitening-related sensitivity, and quote or paraphrase only what it says; otherwise drop the sentence or the link.
